EmailTemplate.subject: Results for your recent blood drive!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [BPL Name],
Thank you for coordinating the [Date] blood drive. We were very pleased with the drive overall, and the willingness of the donors to share this life saving gift.
The efforts of [Account Name] have always been greatly appreciated and their support of the community blood program will go a long way toward replenishing blood supplies and ultimately saving lives.
In addition, we very much appreciate your efforts during this crucial time. You may be interested to know that [#] donors registered, [#] donors were deferred and [#] units were collected! We also registered [#] first time donors!
Again, thank you for your contribution and ongoing support of this important community program. I look forward to working with you again on an upcoming blood drive.
Sincerely, [Account Representative Name] [Contact Information]
